title: A data reload resets the sort to Technician A to Z, and sort is never persisted across visits
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Technician Utilization report with rows loaded.
custom_steps:
1. Sort by Est. Lost Labor descending.
2. Change the date range (a reload) and read the row order.
3. Sort by Total Hours, leave the report, and come back.
custom_expected:
1. After the reload, the rows are back to Technician name A to Z (the sort reset).
2. On the return visit, the sort is again Technician A to Z - sort is NOT persisted (unlike the date range, technician selection, and location selection, which are).
